The following is a list of all of the English language home video releases of the eleventh season of {{aniseries|PTS}}, ''[[S11|Pokémon: DP Battle Dimension]]'', in {{pmin|the United States}} and {{pmin|Canada}} ({{wp|DVD region code|DVD Region 1}}). ==Volume releases== Three ''Pokémon: DP Battle Dimension'' DVD box sets were released by [[VIZ Media]] and distributed through {{wp|Warner Home Video}}. in 2009, containing the whole season between them. There are three boxed sets each containing two volumes with one disc each. The volumes were sold both individually and as part of the box sets. ===Box Set 1: Episodes 1-17=== [[File:DP Battle Dimension Box 1 Cover.png|thumb|200px|Pokémon: DP Battle Dimension - Box Set 1]] Pokémon: DP Battle Dimension - Box Set 1 was released on June 23, 2009. It contains two discs with 17 episodes across them combined. Its catalogue number is DPMDPBDBS01. Optional English closed captioning is included on the DVDs. The contained volumes were released for individual sale on the same day as the box set. {| class="roundtable" style="margin:auto; text-align:center; background: #{{colorschemelight|Sinnoh}}; border: 3px solid #{{colorschemedark|Sinnoh}}" ! (Part 2)]]'' |} ==The Complete Season== [[File:Pokémon the Series DP Battle Dimension The Complete Season DVD.png|thumb|200px|right|Pokémon: DP Battle Dimension - The Complete Season]] Pokémon: DP Battle Dimension - The Complete Season, referred to as Pokémon The Series Diamond and Pearl: Battle Dimension Complete Season on VIZ Media's website, is a [[Complete Collection]] DVD set that was released on January 7, 2020 by [[VIZ Media]] and distributed through {{wp|Warner Home Video}}. This Complete Collection contains seven discs with 52 episodes across them combined. In line with other releases, it includes [[DP071]] and [[DP072]] out of US broadcast order, following [[DP082]] instead of [[DP081]]. Its catalogue number is 3000081796. It consists of a single DVD case in a slip cover. {| class="roundtable" style="margin:auto; text-align:center; background: #{{colorschemelight|Sinnoh}}; border: 3px solid #{{colorschemedark|Sinnoh}};" !
